primary_metrics.name: REDUNDANT_OR_IRRELEVANT_ASK_RATE
primary_metrics.numerator: redundant ASK events + irrelevant ASK events
primary_metrics.formula: (redundant + irrelevant ASK events) / all ASK events
primary_metrics.unit: event-level aggregate; additionally paired case-level any-low-value-ASK yes/no discordance

primary_metrics.name: TASK_COMPLETION_RATE
primary_metrics.formula: complete / evaluable; also publish partial and not_complete counts
primary_metrics.unit: case; report baseline-only/treatment-only/both/neither and discordant pairs

primary_metrics.name: HARMFUL_FAILURE_COUNT
primary_metrics.denominator: evaluable cases; report n and rate with count
primary_metrics.formula: count cases with frozen harmful label

primary_metrics.name: NECESSARY_ASK_PRESERVATION
primary_metrics.numerator: oracle-marked necessary targets acquired via semantically equivalent ASK
primary_metrics.denominator: all oracle-marked necessary ASK targets; report both target and case denominators
primary_metrics.formula: necessary targets acquired via equivalent ASK / oracle-marked necessary targets
primary_metrics.unit: target nested in case; report discordant target counts clustered by case; do not overstate small denominators

primary_metrics.name: CRITICAL_FAILURE_COUNT
primary_metrics.numerator: cases with one or more frozen critical failure types
primary_metrics.denominator: evaluable cases; report n, rate and types
primary_metrics.formula: count cases with >=1 frozen critical failure type
primary_metrics.unit: case; paired binary discordance; no offset against quality metrics

acquisition: ASK count, ASK per case, and frozen ask-quality category counts/rates
RETRIEVE count and RETRIEVE per case
READ_DIARY count and READ_DIARY per case
efficiency: LATENCY_MEAN_MS plus frozen-registry median and nearest-rank p90, overall and by task type
secondary_metrics.token_usage: NOT_MEASURED unless provider-reported values are actually persisted; never estimate

statistical_significance: NO_CLAIM; no new significance test is defined. Follow Step 9.32 statistics only if its inference conditions warrant.
lineage_scoring: provenance metadata only; no additional score; preserve the five existing INCOMPLETE_FORMAL adjudications
